subject: lgcp() in inlabru not working unless reverting to older package versions

messages.author: 89fac3b6a7e30f1c
messages.subject: lgcp() in inlabru not working unless reverting to older package versions
parts:
Hi,

I recently tried running a simple inlabru point process model using lgcp, but kept getting strange results and countless of these messages:

"GMRFLib_2order_approx: rescue NAN/INF values in logl for idx=0"

This is on MacOS Sonoma 14.2.1 (23C71), with latest R version (4.3.2), latest INLA testing version and inlabru developmental version, and other packages updated.
The same issue occurred when running the script on a linux HPC cluster with R 4.2.1.


I was only able to solve the issue by reverting to an even older R version (4.1.2), and the respective older package versions (e.g. R-INLA 22.04.16). 



I have attached the session info, R script, and model summary running the newer package versions (not working), as well as the older ones (working). Both scripts are using the same data and model parameters.

Is there any known fix to this, other than reverting back to older package versions? I remember something similar happening when working in INLA (models suddenly producing "GMRFLib_2order_approx" messages and strange results after updating INLA), so it might be an issue in the R-INLA package?

messages.author: 89fac3b6a7e30f1c
messages.subject: Re: lgcp() in inlabru not working unless reverting to older package versions
parts:
To answer my own question: This seems to be due to problems with the way I specified the model, rather than package version differences.

Changing the model formula from "coordinates" to "geometry", and changing the data format in the "lgcp" call now produces the expected output:

form <- geometry ~ Intercept(1) +
      mySPDE(map = geometry,
             model = matern)
     
# Fit model
model <- lgcp(form,
            data = obs_spatial %>% st_as_sf,
            samplers = ROI %>% st_as_sf,  
            domain = list(geometry = mesh))
